2. core: records (phase 0; users, organisations, people and roles by 20 Nov, mandates and counterparties by 27 Nov)

Every table here also gets created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() and the util.set_updated_at() trigger; they are left out below to keep it readable. S(x) marks a display select using the ref.select_options pattern with set code x.

-- rev 0004_core_people
CREATE TABLE ref.geographies (            -- Attio geographic focus mixes regions and countries
  code text PRIMARY KEY, label text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('region','country','global')),
  region_code text REFERENCES ref.regions ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  country_code char(2) REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CHECK ((kind = 'country') = (country_code IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE core.users (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  attio_workspace_member_id text UNIQUE,
  slack_user_id text UNIQUE,
  email citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  full_name text NOT NULL CHECK (full_name <> ''),
  title text, whatsapp text CHECK (whatsapp ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$'),
  -- Access comes from core.user_roles and core.mandate_team, never from columns here.
  time_zone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Dubai',
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true);

CREATE TABLE core.user_roles (                   -- a user can hold several roles
  user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role_code text REFERENCES ref.roles ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  granted_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  granted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_code));
CREATE INDEX ix_user_roles_role ON core.user_roles (role_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_user_roles_granted_by ON core.user_roles (granted_by);

-- What the API checks on every request.
CREATE VIEW core.v_user_permissions AS
  SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id, rp.permission_code
  FROM core.user_roles ur JOIN ref.role_permissions rp ON rp.role_code = ur.role_code
  JOIN core.users u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.is_active;

CREATE TABLE core.organizations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  attio_record_id text UNIQUE, legacy_attio_id text UNIQUE,
  name text NOT NULL CHECK (name <> ''), description text,
  hq_country char(2) REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  region_code text REFERENCES ref.regions ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  relationship_status text, connection_strength text, employee_range text, estimated_arr text, lead_source text,  -- S(org_relationship_status) S(connection_strength) S(employee_range) S(estimated_arr) S(lead_source)
  lead_tool_code text REFERENCES ref.lead_tools ON DELETE RESTRICT,      -- Attio lead_source_detail
  funding_raised_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (funding_raised_usd >= 0),
  founded_on date, ticket_size_text text, client_type_text text,
  legal_name text, legal_jurisdiction char(2) REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,   -- engagement letters and NDAs
  legal_registration_number text, legal_registered_address text,
  logo_url text, avatar_url text, linkedin_url text, angellist_url text,
  facebook_url text, instagram_url text, twitter_url text,
  twitter_follower_count integer CHECK (twitter_follower_count >= 0),
  source_place_id text UNIQUE,                                            -- Google Maps place
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, is_test boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  attio_synced_at timestamptz, removed_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_organizations_owner ON core.organizations (owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_organizations_hq ON core.organizations (hq_country);
CREATE INDEX ix_organizations_region ON core.organizations (region_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_organizations_lead_tool ON core.organizations (lead_tool_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_organizations_legal_juris ON core.organizations (legal_jurisdiction);
CREATE INDEX ix_organizations_name_trgm ON core.organizations USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE core.organization_domains (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE,
  domain citext NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (domain ~ '^[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$'),
  is_primary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false);
CREATE INDEX ix_org_domains_org ON core.organization_domains (organization_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_org_domains_primary ON core.organization_domains (organization_id) WHERE is_primary;

CREATE TABLE core.organization_types (organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE, type_code text REFERENCES ref.organization_types ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, type_code));
CREATE TABLE core.organization_sector_focus (organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE, sector_code text REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, sector_code));
CREATE TABLE core.organization_stage_focus (organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE, stage_code text REFERENCES ref.investment_stages ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, stage_code));
CREATE TABLE core.organization_geographic_focus (organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE, geography_code text REFERENCES ref.geographies ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, geography_code));
CREATE TABLE core.organization_categories (organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE, category_code text REFERENCES ref.categories ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, category_code));
-- Reverse look-ups for filters ("which buyers focus on F&B").
CREATE INDEX ix_org_types_code ON core.organization_types (type_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_org_sector_code ON core.organization_sector_focus (sector_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_org_stage_code ON core.organization_stage_focus (stage_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_org_geo_code ON core.organization_geographic_focus (geography_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_org_cat_code ON core.organization_categories (category_code);

CREATE TABLE core.organization_interaction_stats (  -- derived; written by the interactions engine
  organization_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE,
  first_interaction_at timestamptz, last_interaction_at timestamptz, next_interaction_at timestamptz,
  first_email_at timestamptz, last_email_at timestamptz,
  first_calendar_at timestamptz, last_calendar_at timestamptz, next_calendar_at timestamptz,
  last_channel text CHECK (last_channel IN ('email','meeting')), last_subject text,
  last_owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  strongest_connection_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  computed_at timestamptz NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_ois_last_owner ON core.organization_interaction_stats (last_owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_ois_strongest ON core.organization_interaction_stats (strongest_connection_user_id);

CREATE TABLE core.people (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  attio_record_id text UNIQUE, legacy_attio_id text UNIQUE, apollo_person_id text UNIQUE,
  full_name text NOT NULL CHECK (full_name <> ''),
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  job_title text, phone text,
  owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  relationship_status text, connection_strength text, contact_type text,   -- S(person_relationship_status) S(connection_strength) S(contact_type)
  linkedin_url text, angellist_url text, facebook_url text, instagram_url text, twitter_url text,
  twitter_follower_count integer CHECK (twitter_follower_count >= 0), avatar_url text,
  is_test boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, attio_synced_at timestamptz, removed_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, updated_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_people_org ON core.people (organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_people_owner ON core.people (owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_people_name_trgm ON core.people USING gin (full_name gin_trgm_ops) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE core.person_emails (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  person_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email citext NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (email ~ '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'),
  is_primary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('attio','gmail','calendar','apollo','manual')));
CREATE INDEX ix_person_emails_person ON core.person_emails (person_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_person_emails_primary ON core.person_emails (person_id) WHERE is_primary;

CREATE TABLE core.person_roles (person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE CASCADE, role_code text REFERENCES ref.person_roles ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (person_id, role_code));
CREATE INDEX ix_person_roles_code ON core.person_roles (role_code);

CREATE TABLE core.person_interaction_stats (
  person_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE CASCADE,
  first_interaction_at timestamptz, last_interaction_at timestamptz, next_interaction_at timestamptz,
  first_email_at timestamptz, last_email_at timestamptz,
  first_calendar_at timestamptz, last_calendar_at timestamptz, next_calendar_at timestamptz,
  last_channel text CHECK (last_channel IN ('email','meeting')), last_subject text,
  last_owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  strongest_connection_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  computed_at timestamptz NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_pis_last_owner ON core.person_interaction_stats (last_owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_pis_strongest ON core.person_interaction_stats (strongest_connection_user_id);
-- rev 0005_core_roles
CREATE TABLE core.buyer_roles (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  attio_entry_id text UNIQUE, legacy_entry_id text UNIQUE,
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  target_sector_code text REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,     -- Attio target_vertical
  model text, mandate_status text, deal_structure text, relationship_warmth text,  -- S(buyer_model) S(buyer_mandate_status) S(deal_structure) S(warmth)
  ebitda_floor_usd numeric(18,2), ebitda_ceiling_usd numeric(18,2),
  check_size_min_usd numeric(18,2), check_size_max_usd numeric(18,2), ev_ceiling_usd numeric(18,2),
  estimated_aum_usd numeric(18,2),
  CHECK (check_size_max_usd IS NULL OR check_size_min_usd IS NULL OR check_size_max_usd >= check_size_min_usd),
  CHECK (ebitda_ceiling_usd IS NULL OR ebitda_floor_usd IS NULL OR ebitda_ceiling_usd >= ebitda_floor_usd),
  earnout_tolerance boolean, profitable_only boolean,
  investment_strategy text, notes text, acquisition_enrichment text, notable_investments text,
  key_personnel text, prior_gcc_acquisition text, target_stage_text text, ticket_size_text text,
  key_contact_person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE SET NULL,
  last_mandate_briefing_on date,
  do_not_contact boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, is_test boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  attio_synced_at timestamptz, removed_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (id, organization_id));          -- target of the composite keys that keep role and company consistent
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_buyer_roles_org_sector ON core.buyer_roles (organization_id, target_sector_code) NULLS NOT DISTINCT WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_buyer_roles_sector ON core.buyer_roles (target_sector_code) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_buyer_roles_contact ON core.buyer_roles (key_contact_person_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_buyer_roles_owner ON core.buyer_roles (owner_user_id);
CREATE TABLE core.buyer_role_geographies (buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE CASCADE, geography_code text REFERENCES ref.geographies ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (buyer_role_id, geography_code));
CREATE INDEX ix_buyer_role_geo_code ON core.buyer_role_geographies (geography_code);

-- One row per Attio seller_role list entry (all 60 attributes); organisation fields live only in core.organizations.
CREATE TABLE core.seller_roles (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  attio_entry_id text UNIQUE, legacy_entry_id text UNIQUE,
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  -- Pipeline and triage
  outreach_tier text, appetite_signal text, relationship_status text, sell_timeline text,
  last_attempt_channel text, last_attempt_outcome text, lead_priority text, quality_check text, funding_stage text,
  -- S(outreach_tier) S(appetite_signal) S(seller_relationship_status) S(sell_timeline) S(attempt_channel)
  -- S(attempt_outcome) S(lead_priority) S(quality_check) S(funding_stage)
  re_engage_on date, last_attempt_on date,
  lead_quality_score numeric(5,2), routing_reason text, recommended_referral text,
  data_consent boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  years_active smallint CHECK (years_active >= 0), location_count integer CHECK (location_count >= 0),
  headcount integer CHECK (headcount >= 0),
  -- Figures
  est_revenue_usd numeric(18,2), est_ebitda_usd numeric(18,2), ebitda_adjusted_usd numeric(18,2),
  ebitda_deducts_salary boolean, owner_salary_usd numeric(18,2),
  revenue_last_full_year_usd numeric(18,2), revenue_year_before_usd numeric(18,2),
  gross_margin_pct numeric(5,2), largest_customer_revenue_pct numeric(5,2) CHECK (largest_customer_revenue_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  repeat_revenue_pct numeric(5,2) CHECK (repeat_revenue_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  annual_rent_cost_usd numeric(18,2), days_to_get_paid smallint CHECK (days_to_get_paid >= 0),
  valuation_low_usd numeric(18,2), valuation_mid_usd numeric(18,2), valuation_high_usd numeric(18,2),
  CHECK (valuation_low_usd IS NULL OR valuation_high_usd IS NULL OR valuation_low_usd <= valuation_high_usd),
  implied_ev_low_usd numeric(18,2), implied_ev_high_usd numeric(18,2),
  readiness_score numeric(5,2), readiness_band text,                       -- S(readiness_band)
  -- Benchmark (GCC SME Benchmark tool)
  benchmark_score numeric(5,2), benchmark_band text, benchmark_quartile text, benchmark_review text,  -- S(benchmark_band) S(benchmark_quartile) S(benchmark_review)
  include_in_benchmark boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, review_note text, headline_flag text,
  pct_ebitda_margin numeric(5,2), pct_revenue_growth numeric(5,2), pct_revenue_per_employee numeric(5,2),
  pct_concentration numeric(5,2), pct_gross_margin numeric(5,2), pct_premises_cost numeric(5,2),
  pct_recurring_revenue numeric(5,2), pct_capital_efficiency numeric(5,2), pct_revenue_scale numeric(5,2),
  -- Ownership and sync
  owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, is_test boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  attio_synced_at timestamptz, removed_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (id, organization_id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_seller_roles_org ON core.seller_roles (organization_id) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_seller_roles_owner ON core.seller_roles (owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_seller_roles_appetite ON core.seller_roles (appetite_signal) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_seller_roles_revenue ON core.seller_roles (est_revenue_usd) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_seller_roles_ebitda ON core.seller_roles (est_ebitda_usd) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE core.seller_role_sectors (seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE CASCADE, sector_code text REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (seller_role_id, sector_code));
CREATE INDEX ix_seller_role_sectors_code ON core.seller_role_sectors (sector_code);

-- Search lists (nursery, pharmatech) and Engine owner-approach lists.
CREATE TABLE core.prospect_lists (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(), attio_list_id text UNIQUE,
  name text NOT NULL UNIQUE, kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('search','owner_approach')),
  looking_for text NOT NULL CHECK (looking_for IN ('sellers','buyers')),
  mandate_id uuid, mandate_side text,      -- set when the search serves a client; FK added in rev 0006
  CHECK ((mandate_id IS NULL) = (mandate_side IS NULL)),
  CHECK (mandate_id IS NULL OR (mandate_side = 'buy' AND looking_for = 'sellers') OR (mandate_side = 'sell' AND looking_for = 'buyers')),
  created_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, removed_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (id, looking_for));
CREATE TABLE core.prospect_list_criteria (
  list_id uuid REFERENCES core.prospect_lists ON DELETE CASCADE, code text, label text NOT NULL,
  attio_attribute text, position smallint NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (list_id, code));
CREATE TABLE core.prospect_list_entries (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  list_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.prospect_lists ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  list_looking_for text NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (list_id, list_looking_for) REFERENCES core.prospect_lists (id, looking_for) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  -- Every entry is a role: a seller role on a sellers list, a buyer role on a buyers list.
  seller_role_id uuid, buyer_role_id uuid,
  FOREIGN KEY (seller_role_id, organization_id) REFERENCES core.seller_roles (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  FOREIGN KEY (buyer_role_id, organization_id) REFERENCES core.buyer_roles (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CHECK ((list_looking_for = 'sellers' AND seller_role_id IS NOT NULL AND buyer_role_id IS NULL)
      OR (list_looking_for = 'buyers'  AND buyer_role_id IS NOT NULL AND seller_role_id IS NULL)),
  attio_entry_id text UNIQUE, branch_count integer CHECK (branch_count >= 0), evidence text,
  added_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, removed_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (id, list_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_ple_list_kind ON core.prospect_list_entries (list_id, list_looking_for);
CREATE INDEX ix_ple_seller_role ON core.prospect_list_entries (seller_role_id, organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_ple_buyer_role ON core.prospect_list_entries (buyer_role_id, organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_prospect_lists_mandate ON core.prospect_lists (mandate_id, mandate_side);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_ple_list_org ON core.prospect_list_entries (list_id, organization_id) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_ple_org ON core.prospect_list_entries (organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_ple_added_by ON core.prospect_list_entries (added_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_prospect_lists_creator ON core.prospect_lists (created_by);
CREATE TABLE core.prospect_list_answers (
  entry_id uuid NOT NULL, list_id uuid NOT NULL, criterion_code text NOT NULL,
  answer text NOT NULL CHECK (answer IN ('yes','no','unverified')),
  PRIMARY KEY (entry_id, criterion_code),
  FOREIGN KEY (entry_id, list_id) REFERENCES core.prospect_list_entries (id, list_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (list_id, criterion_code) REFERENCES core.prospect_list_criteria (list_id, code) ON DELETE RESTRICT);
CREATE INDEX ix_pla_list_criterion ON core.prospect_list_answers (list_id, criterion_code);
-- rev 0006_core_mandates
CREATE TABLE core.mandates (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  attio_record_id text UNIQUE, legacy_attio_id text,
  code_name citext NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (code_name <> ''),
  name text NOT NULL,                                                      -- Attio deal_name
  side text NOT NULL CHECK (side IN ('buy','sell')),
  stage_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.mandate_stages ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  status_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' REFERENCES ref.mandate_statuses ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  -- The client is always a role: a seller role on sell-side, a buyer role on buy-side.
  client_seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  client_buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  client_person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE RESTRICT,   -- only an individual buy-side client (Attio buyer_id → person)
  CHECK ((side = 'sell' AND client_seller_role_id IS NOT NULL AND client_buyer_role_id IS NULL AND client_person_id IS NULL)
      OR (side = 'buy'  AND client_seller_role_id IS NULL AND num_nonnulls(client_buyer_role_id, client_person_id) = 1)),
  owner_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  sector_code text REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  city text, country_code char(2) REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  deal_value_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (deal_value_usd >= 0),
  estimated_deal_value_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (estimated_deal_value_usd >= 0),
  asking_price_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (asking_price_usd >= 0),
  start_on date, expiry_on date CHECK (expiry_on IS NULL OR start_on IS NULL OR expiry_on >= start_on),
  contract_signed_on date, exclusivity_on date, expected_close_on date, first_round_due_on date,
  shortlist_approved_at timestamptz,
  next_step text, next_step_due_on date,
  next_step_owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source_partner_id uuid,                -- FK to firm.partners added in rev 0014
  drive_folder_id text UNIQUE,
  is_test boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, attio_synced_at timestamptz, removed_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, updated_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  UNIQUE (id, side));                    -- lets counterparties and lists check the side
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_board ON core.mandates (status_code, owner_user_id, stage_code) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;  -- Pipeline default view
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_owner ON core.mandates (owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_stage ON core.mandates (stage_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_client_seller ON core.mandates (client_seller_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_client_buyer ON core.mandates (client_buyer_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_client_person ON core.mandates (client_person_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_sector ON core.mandates (sector_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_country ON core.mandates (country_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_next_owner ON core.mandates (next_step_owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_partner ON core.mandates (source_partner_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_creator ON core.mandates (created_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_updater ON core.mandates (updated_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandates_search_trgm ON core.mandates USING gin ((code_name::text || ' ' || name) gin_trgm_ops) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;  -- Cmd+K

ALTER TABLE core.prospect_lists ADD CONSTRAINT fk_prospect_lists_mandate
  FOREIGN KEY (mandate_id, mandate_side) REFERENCES core.mandates (id, side) ON DELETE RESTRICT;

CREATE TABLE core.code_names (                    -- pool for New deal suggestions
  code_name citext PRIMARY KEY,
  mandate_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  reserved_at timestamptz);

-- Who works on a deal. Advisors sync to Attio's assigned_advisor; an analyst with
-- deals.view_staffed sees only the mandates listed here.
CREATE TABLE core.mandate_team (
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  team_role text NOT NULL CHECK (team_role IN ('advisor','analyst')),
  added_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (mandate_id, user_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_mandate_team_user ON core.mandate_team (user_id, mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandate_team_added_by ON core.mandate_team (added_by);

CREATE TABLE core.mandate_stage_history (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  mandate_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  stage_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.mandate_stages ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  status_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.mandate_statuses ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  entered_at timestamptz NOT NULL, left_at timestamptz CHECK (left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= entered_at),
  changed_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('engine','attio','backfill')));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_msh_open ON core.mandate_stage_history (mandate_id) WHERE left_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_msh_mandate_time ON core.mandate_stage_history (mandate_id, entered_at);  -- stage bar: sum days per stage_code, open row to now()
CREATE INDEX ix_msh_stage_time ON core.mandate_stage_history (stage_code, entered_at);  -- medians and conversion
CREATE INDEX ix_msh_status ON core.mandate_stage_history (status_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_msh_changed_by ON core.mandate_stage_history (changed_by);

CREATE TABLE core.mandate_contacts (
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  role text NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('client','client_adviser','other')),
  position smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (mandate_id, person_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_mandate_contacts_person ON core.mandate_contacts (person_id);

CREATE TABLE core.mandate_financials (
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  fiscal_year smallint CHECK (fiscal_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100),
  revenue_usd numeric(18,2), gross_profit_usd numeric(18,2), ebitda_usd numeric(18,2),  -- converted at entry (Gulf currencies are pegged)
  is_actual boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  PRIMARY KEY (mandate_id, fiscal_year));

CREATE TABLE core.mandate_blurbs (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  mandate_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  body text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft','approved','superseded')),
  model text, prompt_version text,
  approved_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, approved_at timestamptz,
  CHECK ((status = 'approved') = (approved_at IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mandate_blurbs_approved ON core.mandate_blurbs (mandate_id) WHERE status = 'approved';
CREATE INDEX ix_mandate_blurbs_mandate ON core.mandate_blurbs (mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_mandate_blurbs_approver ON core.mandate_blurbs (approved_by);

-- A counterparty is always a role: buyers on a sell-side mandate or a buyers list,
-- sellers (targets) on a buy-side mandate or a sellers list. Composite keys make the
-- database check the side and that the role belongs to the same company.
CREATE TABLE core.counterparties (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  mandate_id uuid, mandate_side text,
  FOREIGN KEY (mandate_id, mandate_side) REFERENCES core.mandates (id, side) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  prospect_list_id uuid, list_looking_for text,
  FOREIGN KEY (prospect_list_id, list_looking_for) REFERENCES core.prospect_lists (id, looking_for) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CHECK (num_nonnulls(mandate_id, prospect_list_id) = 1),
  CHECK ((mandate_id IS NULL) = (mandate_side IS NULL)),
  CHECK ((prospect_list_id IS NULL) = (list_looking_for IS NULL)),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  buyer_role_id uuid, seller_role_id uuid,
  FOREIGN KEY (buyer_role_id, organization_id) REFERENCES core.buyer_roles (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  FOREIGN KEY (seller_role_id, organization_id) REFERENCES core.seller_roles (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CHECK (CASE WHEN mandate_side = 'sell' OR list_looking_for = 'buyers'
              THEN buyer_role_id IS NOT NULL AND seller_role_id IS NULL
              ELSE seller_role_id IS NOT NULL AND buyer_role_id IS NULL END),
  status_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_contacted' REFERENCES ref.counterparty_statuses ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  status_changed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  passed_reason text, CHECK (status_code <> 'passed' OR passed_reason IS NOT NULL),
  rationale text, nda_signed_on date,
  next_step text, next_step_due_on date,
  owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('match','search','manual','import','attio')),
  search_candidate_id uuid,             -- FK to intake.search_candidates added in rev 0007
  attio_pair_deal_record_id text UNIQUE, -- legacy buyer–seller pair deals
  is_test boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, removed_at timestamptz);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cp_mandate_org ON core.counterparties (mandate_id, organization_id) WHERE mandate_id IS NOT NULL AND removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cp_list_org ON core.counterparties (prospect_list_id, organization_id) WHERE prospect_list_id IS NOT NULL AND removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_mandate ON core.counterparties (mandate_id, mandate_side);
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_mandate_status ON core.counterparties (mandate_id, status_code) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;  -- Buyers tab, funnel
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_list ON core.counterparties (prospect_list_id, list_looking_for);
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_org ON core.counterparties (organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_owner_due ON core.counterparties (owner_user_id, next_step_due_on) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;  -- Outreach
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_buyer_role ON core.counterparties (buyer_role_id, organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_seller_role ON core.counterparties (seller_role_id, organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_status ON core.counterparties (status_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_candidate ON core.counterparties (search_candidate_id);

CREATE TABLE core.counterparty_contacts (
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE CASCADE,
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  position smallint NOT NULL,                 -- 0 = key contact
  PRIMARY KEY (counterparty_id, person_id),
  UNIQUE (counterparty_id, position));
CREATE INDEX ix_cp_contacts_person ON core.counterparty_contacts (person_id);

-- One row per status a buyer or seller passes through on a deal, like mandate_stage_history.
-- The crm module writes it in the same transaction as counterparties.status_code.
-- Backfill: one open row per existing counterparty at status_changed_at, source 'backfill'.
CREATE TABLE core.counterparty_status_history (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  counterparty_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.counterparty_statuses ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  entered_at timestamptz NOT NULL, left_at timestamptz CHECK (left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= entered_at),
  passed_reason text, CHECK (status_code <> 'passed' OR passed_reason IS NOT NULL),
  changed_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('engine','attio','backfill')));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_csh_open ON core.counterparty_status_history (counterparty_id) WHERE left_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_csh_cp_time ON core.counterparty_status_history (counterparty_id, entered_at);     -- one buyer's timeline
CREATE INDEX ix_csh_status_time ON core.counterparty_status_history (status_code, entered_at);     -- teaser-to-NDA medians
CREATE INDEX ix_csh_changed_by ON core.counterparty_status_history (changed_by);

CREATE TABLE core.notes (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  attio_record_id text UNIQUE, legacy_note_id text UNIQUE,
  note_type text NOT NULL CHECK (note_type IN ('manual','meeting')),
  primary_role text CHECK (primary_role IN ('seller','buyer','investor','internal','general')),
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE SET NULL,
  buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  meeting_id uuid,                       -- FK to comms.meetings added in rev 0009
  content text NOT NULL, noted_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  author_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  is_test boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, removed_at timestamptz);
CREATE INDEX ix_notes_org_time ON core.notes (organization_id, noted_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_notes_person ON core.notes (person_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_notes_buyer_role ON core.notes (buyer_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_notes_seller_role ON core.notes (seller_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_notes_mandate_time ON core.notes (mandate_id, noted_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_notes_meeting ON core.notes (meeting_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_notes_author ON core.notes (author_user_id);

Views in the same revisions: core.v_buyer_roles_usd and core.v_seller_roles_usd (universe screens), core.v_mandate_attio (the Deal_V2 fields the outbox writes, including derived NDA count, universe and shortlist size, contacted, responses, interested and time in stage), and analytics.mandate_funnel (section 8: sent, opened, replied, NDA signed, meeting held, IOI received per mandate).

3. intake and market (phase 0, by 27 Nov)

Every new company, contact or comp enters through intake and is checked for duplicates on domain, then name plus sector, before it touches core or market. Each stored value records where it came from.

-- rev 0007_intake
CREATE TABLE intake.import_batches (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('excel','claude','lead_magnet','discovery','apollo','manual')),
  target_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (target_kind IN ('buyer','seller','organization','person','comp')),
  file_name text,
  uploaded_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'processing' CHECK (status IN ('processing','ready','approved','rejected','failed')),
  decided_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, decided_at timestamptz,
  failure_reason text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());
CREATE INDEX ix_import_batches_open ON intake.import_batches (created_at DESC) WHERE status = 'ready';
CREATE INDEX ix_import_batches_uploader ON intake.import_batches (uploaded_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_batches_decider ON intake.import_batches (decided_by);

CREATE TABLE intake.import_rows (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES intake.import_batches ON DELETE CASCADE,
  row_number integer NOT NULL CHECK (row_number > 0),
  name text, domain citext, website text,
  sector_code text REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  country_code char(2) REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  contact_name text, contact_email citext, contact_title text,
  -- The file or request body is the batch's raw input (audit.raw_inputs); row_number points into it.
  match_organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  match_kind text CHECK (match_kind IN ('domain','name_sector','none')),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','merged','test')),
  created_organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  -- A buyer or seller import is only approved once the row has its role.
  buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CHECK (num_nonnulls(buyer_role_id, seller_role_id) <= 1),
  CHECK (status NOT IN ('approved','merged') OR coalesce(created_organization_id, match_organization_id) IS NOT NULL),
  decided_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, decided_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (batch_id, row_number));
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_buyer_role ON intake.import_rows (buyer_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_seller_role ON intake.import_rows (seller_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_batch_status ON intake.import_rows (batch_id, status);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_domain ON intake.import_rows (domain);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_match ON intake.import_rows (match_organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_created ON intake.import_rows (created_organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_sector ON intake.import_rows (sector_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_country ON intake.import_rows (country_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_import_rows_decider ON intake.import_rows (decided_by);

CREATE TABLE intake.lead_submissions (           -- lead magnets and gated-report unlocks
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  import_row_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES intake.import_rows ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tool_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.lead_tools ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  submitted_at timestamptz NOT NULL, email citext,
  score numeric(6,2), band text,
  valuation_low_usd numeric(18,2), valuation_high_usd numeric(18,2),
  report_slug text, utm_source text, utm_medium text, utm_campaign text, posthog_distinct_id text);
  -- The full submission, answers included, is its raw input (raw_input_id, added in rev 0015).
CREATE INDEX ix_lead_submissions_tool_time ON intake.lead_submissions (tool_code, submitted_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE intake.search_runs (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('buyer_search','seller_search','find_more','match')),
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  run_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  describe_text text, query_text text,
  filters jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',           -- our own filter model, validated by Pydantic
  match_run_id uuid,                              -- existing matching run, when one was used
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running' CHECK (status IN ('running','done','failed')),
  started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), finished_at timestamptz);
CREATE INDEX ix_search_runs_user_time ON intake.search_runs (run_by, started_at DESC);   -- "search remembers its last search"
CREATE INDEX ix_search_runs_mandate ON intake.search_runs (mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_search_runs_buyer_role ON intake.search_runs (buyer_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_search_runs_seller_role ON intake.search_runs (seller_role_id);

CREATE TABLE intake.search_candidates (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  search_run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES intake.search_runs ON DELETE CASCADE,
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,   -- set when we already hold it
  name text NOT NULL, domain citext, website text,
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('our_data','google_maps','apollo','web')),
  rationale text, score numeric(5,2),
  employees integer CHECK (employees >= 0), revenue_usd numeric(18,2),
  sector_code text REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  country_code char(2) REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'suggested' CHECK (status IN ('suggested','added','dismissed')),
  dismissed_reason text, CHECK (status <> 'dismissed' OR dismissed_reason IS NOT NULL),
  decided_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, decided_at timestamptz,
  import_row_id uuid REFERENCES intake.import_rows ON DELETE SET NULL,
  -- Added means it became a role (and a counterparty when the run serves a mandate).
  buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CHECK (num_nonnulls(buyer_role_id, seller_role_id) <= 1),
  CHECK (status <> 'added' OR num_nonnulls(buyer_role_id, seller_role_id) = 1));
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_buyer_role ON intake.search_candidates (buyer_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_seller_role ON intake.search_candidates (seller_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_run_status ON intake.search_candidates (search_run_id, status);
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_org ON intake.search_candidates (organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_import_row ON intake.search_candidates (import_row_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_sector ON intake.search_candidates (sector_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_country ON intake.search_candidates (country_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_decider ON intake.search_candidates (decided_by);
ALTER TABLE core.counterparties ADD CONSTRAINT fk_counterparties_candidate
  FOREIGN KEY (search_candidate_id) REFERENCES intake.search_candidates ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE TABLE intake.staged_contacts (            -- contacts found before the company is in core
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  search_candidate_id uuid REFERENCES intake.search_candidates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  import_row_id uuid REFERENCES intake.import_rows ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CHECK (num_nonnulls(search_candidate_id, import_row_id) = 1),
  full_name text NOT NULL, job_title text, email citext, linkedin_url text, apollo_person_id text,
  promoted_person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_staged_contacts_candidate ON intake.staged_contacts (search_candidate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_staged_contacts_row ON intake.staged_contacts (import_row_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_staged_contacts_person ON intake.staged_contacts (promoted_person_id);

-- Where each stored value came from (one row per record per field).
CREATE TABLE intake.field_sources (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE,
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE CASCADE,
  buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE CASCADE,
  seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CHECK (num_nonnulls(organization_id, person_id, buyer_role_id, seller_role_id) = 1),
  field_code text NOT NULL,                        -- the Attio slug from audit.attio_field_map
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('attio','user','diffbot','pdl','web','apollo','scribe','gmail','lead_magnet','import')),
  confidence numeric(3,2) CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  source_url text, observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  set_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_fs_org ON intake.field_sources (organization_id, field_code) WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_fs_person ON intake.field_sources (person_id, field_code) WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_fs_buyer ON intake.field_sources (buyer_role_id, field_code) WHERE buyer_role_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_fs_seller ON intake.field_sources (seller_role_id, field_code) WHERE seller_role_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_fs_set_by ON intake.field_sources (set_by);

-- Proposed changes from Scribe, Gmail, enrichment or an Attio-side edit, waiting for a person.
CREATE TABLE intake.field_proposals (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE CASCADE,
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE CASCADE,
  buyer_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.buyer_roles ON DELETE CASCADE,
  seller_role_id uuid REFERENCES core.seller_roles ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CHECK (num_nonnulls(organization_id, person_id, buyer_role_id, seller_role_id) = 1),
  field_code text NOT NULL, proposed_value text NOT NULL, current_value text,
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('attio','diffbot','pdl','web','apollo','scribe','gmail','claude')),
  confidence numeric(3,2) CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  evidence_quote text, evidence_url text,
  meeting_id uuid, email_message_id uuid,           -- FKs added in rev 0009
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','accepted','rejected','superseded')),
  decided_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, decided_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_pending ON intake.field_proposals (created_at DESC) WHERE status = 'pending';
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_org ON intake.field_proposals (organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_person ON intake.field_proposals (person_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_buyer ON intake.field_proposals (buyer_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_seller ON intake.field_proposals (seller_role_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_meeting ON intake.field_proposals (meeting_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_message ON intake.field_proposals (email_message_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fp_decider ON intake.field_proposals (decided_by);
-- rev 0008_market
CREATE TABLE market.comp_datasets (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  name text NOT NULL UNIQUE, publisher text, published_on date,
  import_batch_id uuid REFERENCES intake.import_batches ON DELETE SET NULL,
  loaded_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_comp_datasets_batch ON market.comp_datasets (import_batch_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_comp_datasets_loader ON market.comp_datasets (loaded_by);

CREATE TABLE market.comps (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  dataset_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES market.comp_datasets ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  target_name text NOT NULL, acquirer_name text,
  target_organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  acquirer_organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  sector_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  sub_sector_code text REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  country_code char(2) NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  deal_on date NOT NULL,
  deal_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unspecified' CHECK (deal_type IN ('strategic','sponsor','unspecified')),  -- valuation.json has no deal type
  theme text,                             -- the source's theme tags, as given
  enterprise_value_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (enterprise_value_usd > 0),  -- converted at the deal-date rate
  revenue_usd numeric(18,2), ebitda_usd numeric(18,2),
  fx_rate_on date,                        -- rate date used when the source was a floating currency (EUR, GBP, EGP)
  ev_ebitda numeric(8,2) CHECK (ev_ebitda > 0), ev_revenue numeric(8,2) CHECK (ev_revenue > 0),
  CHECK (num_nonnulls(ev_ebitda, ev_revenue) >= 1),
  source_name text NOT NULL, source_url text,
  verified_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, verified_at timestamptz,
  is_verified boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (verified_at IS NOT NULL) STORED,
  removed_at timestamptz);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_comps_deal ON market.comps (lower(target_name), deal_on, lower(coalesce(acquirer_name, '')), coalesce(enterprise_value_usd, 0)) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;  -- the same deal twice = same target, date, acquirer and value
CREATE INDEX ix_comps_lookup ON market.comps (sector_code, country_code, deal_on DESC)
  INCLUDE (ev_ebitda, ev_revenue, enterprise_value_usd) WHERE is_verified AND removed_at IS NULL;  -- Multiples median
CREATE INDEX ix_comps_sub_sector ON market.comps (sub_sector_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_comps_dataset ON market.comps (dataset_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_comps_target_org ON market.comps (target_organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_comps_acquirer_org ON market.comps (acquirer_organization_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_comps_country ON market.comps (country_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_comps_verifier ON market.comps (verified_by);

CREATE TABLE market.web_comp_results (            -- never part of a median until promoted
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  search_run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES intake.search_runs ON DELETE CASCADE,
  url text NOT NULL, page_title text,
  target_name text, country_code char(2) REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  deal_on date, ev_ebitda numeric(8,2), ev_revenue numeric(8,2), enterprise_value_usd numeric(18,2),
  fetched_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  promoted_comp_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES market.comps ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_web_comps_run ON market.web_comp_results (search_run_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_web_comps_country ON market.web_comp_results (country_code);

-- Added 16 Nov so every dataset in the valuation tool's valuation.json has a home (1,000 transactions, 127 VC rounds,
-- 268 listed comps in 31 groups, 91 WACC industries, 32 growth rows). The migration seeds them with verified_at = the
-- migration time and verified_by NULL (imported as trusted), so medians and valuations match today's, and one evidence row per record pointing into the uploaded file. Its report lists what
-- it cannot place: the transaction with no multiple, the exact Kaleyra repeat, the 4 tags with no sector
-- (Alcohol, Cannabis, Casinos & Gambling, Online Betting) and 'Other Financial Services'. HQs given as ISO-3 codes or names
-- map to ref.countries. Amounts in USD millions become whole USD. The valuation's sector mappings stay in code for now.
CREATE TABLE ref.valuation_groups (                -- the 33 keys that listed comps and growth assumptions are filed under
  code text PRIMARY KEY, label text NOT NULL UNIQUE, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true);

CREATE TABLE market.comp_sectors (                 -- every vertical tag a transaction carries (up to 6); comps.sector_code is the first
  comp_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES market.comps ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sector_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  PRIMARY KEY (comp_id, sector_code));
CREATE INDEX ix_comp_sectors_sector ON market.comp_sectors (sector_code);

CREATE TABLE market.vc_rounds (                    -- venture rounds, matched to a sector and stage by the Industry Research method
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  dataset_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES market.comp_datasets ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  company_name text NOT NULL,
  sector_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.sectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  stage text NOT NULL CHECK (stage <> ''),          -- as the source gives it (13 values today); the valuation maps them to its 8 stages in code
  country_code char(2) NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.countries ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  round_on date,                                    -- the source carries no date
  valuation_usd numeric(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (valuation_usd > 0),
  raised_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (raised_usd > 0),
  revenue_fy_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (revenue_fy_usd > 0),            -- r24: the last reported year
  revenue_forward_usd numeric(18,2) CHECK (revenue_forward_usd > 0),  -- r25: the forecast year
  fy_multiple numeric(10,4) CHECK (fy_multiple > 0),                  -- valuation over revenue_fy, kept as the source rounded it
  forward_multiple numeric(10,4) CHECK (forward_multiple > 0),
  CHECK ((fy_multiple IS NULL) = (revenue_fy_usd IS NULL) AND (forward_multiple IS NULL) = (revenue_forward_usd IS NULL)),
  CHECK (fy_multiple IS NULL OR abs(fy_multiple - valuation_usd / revenue_fy_usd) <= 0.01),            -- an edit cannot leave a stale multiple
  CHECK (forward_multiple IS NULL OR abs(forward_multiple - valuation_usd / revenue_forward_usd) <= 0.01),
  source_name text NOT NULL, source_url text,
  verified_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, verified_at timestamptz,
  is_verified boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (verified_at IS NOT NULL) STORED,
  removed_at timestamptz);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_vc_rounds ON market.vc_rounds (lower(company_name), stage, valuation_usd, coalesce(raised_usd, 0)) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_vc_rounds_lookup ON market.vc_rounds (sector_code, stage) WHERE is_verified AND removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_vc_rounds_dataset ON market.vc_rounds (dataset_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_vc_rounds_country ON market.vc_rounds (country_code);
CREATE INDEX ix_vc_rounds_verifier ON market.vc_rounds (verified_by);

CREATE TABLE market.listed_comps (                 -- listed and a few pre-IPO peers; EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA are worked out on read
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  dataset_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES market.comp_datasets ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  group_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.valuation_groups ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  company_name text NOT NULL,
  ticker text NOT NULL,                             -- 'PRIVATE' for the pre-IPO peers
  enterprise_value_usd numeric(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (enterprise_value_usd > 0),
  revenue_usd numeric(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (revenue_usd > 0),
  ebitda_usd numeric(18,2),                         -- zero or negative for 51 of 268: they get no EV/EBITDA
  as_of date,                                       -- the source carries no date
  source_name text NOT NULL, source_url text,
  verified_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, verified_at timestamptz,
  is_verified boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (verified_at IS NOT NULL) STORED,
  removed_at timestamptz);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_listed_comps ON market.listed_comps (group_code, lower(company_name)) WHERE removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_listed_comps_group ON market.listed_comps (group_code) WHERE is_verified AND removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_listed_comps_dataset ON market.listed_comps (dataset_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_listed_comps_verifier ON market.listed_comps (verified_by);

CREATE TABLE market.valuation_rules (              -- cost of capital by industry and growth assumptions by group; percent points (9.85 = 9.85%)
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('wacc','growth')),
  industry text,                                    -- wacc: the Damodaran industry
  group_code text REFERENCES ref.valuation_groups ON DELETE RESTRICT,   -- growth: the group
  cost_of_equity_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (cost_of_equity_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  cost_of_debt_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (cost_of_debt_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  revenue_growth_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (revenue_growth_pct BETWEEN -100 AND 500),
  ebit_margin_improvement_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (ebit_margin_improvement_pct BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
  depreciation_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (depreciation_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  capex_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (capex_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  working_capital_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (working_capital_pct BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
  terminal_growth_pct numeric(6,2) CHECK (terminal_growth_pct BETWEEN -10 AND 20),
  CHECK ((kind = 'wacc' AND industry IS NOT NULL AND group_code IS NULL
          AND num_nonnulls(cost_of_equity_pct, cost_of_debt_pct) = 2
          AND num_nonnulls(revenue_growth_pct, ebit_margin_improvement_pct, depreciation_pct, capex_pct, working_capital_pct, terminal_growth_pct) = 0)
      OR (kind = 'growth' AND group_code IS NOT NULL AND industry IS NULL
          AND num_nonnulls(cost_of_equity_pct, cost_of_debt_pct) = 0
          AND num_nonnulls(revenue_growth_pct, ebit_margin_improvement_pct, depreciation_pct, capex_pct, working_capital_pct, terminal_growth_pct) = 6)),
  source_name text NOT NULL, source_url text,
  verified_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL, verified_at timestamptz,
  is_verified boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (verified_at IS NOT NULL) STORED,
  removed_at timestamptz);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rules_wacc ON market.valuation_rules (lower(industry)) WHERE kind = 'wacc' AND removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rules_growth ON market.valuation_rules (group_code) WHERE kind = 'growth' AND removed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_rules_verifier ON market.valuation_rules (verified_by);

4. comms and outreach (phase 0, by 4 Dec)

Email is stored as metadata plus a short snippet; bodies are fetched from Gmail on demand. A send is only possible from an approved draft, and the database enforces that every sent draft names its approver.

-- rev 0009_comms
-- Google mail and calendar use domain-wide delegation (PR #396), not per-user sign-in: one connection row
-- per team mailbox, connector google_delegated, secret_arn = the shared service-account key.
-- The interactions module owns this schema; its poll pass feeds the gmail_sync and calendar_sync queues.
CREATE TABLE comms.user_connections (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,        -- NULL for firm-wide connectors (Apollo, Notion)
  connector_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.connectors ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  account_label text NOT NULL,
  secret_arn text NOT NULL,                                     -- the token lives in Secrets Manager
  scopes text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('connected','needs_attention','revoked')),
  issue text, CHECK (status <> 'needs_attention' OR issue IS NOT NULL),
  last_sync_at timestamptz, connected_at timestamptz NOT NULL, revoked_at timestamptz);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_connections_live ON comms.user_connections (user_id, connector_code) NULLS NOT DISTINCT WHERE revoked_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_connections_connector ON comms.user_connections (connector_code);

CREATE TABLE comms.sync_cursors (                 -- replaces mailbox_sync_cursors
  connection_id uuid REFERENCES comms.user_connections ON DELETE CASCADE,
  stream text CHECK (stream IN ('gmail','calendar','drive')),
  cursor text, backfill_page_token text, backfill_completed_at timestamptz,
  last_synced_at timestamptz, watch_expires_at timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY (connection_id, stream));

CREATE TABLE comms.email_threads (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  connection_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES comms.user_connections ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  gmail_thread_id text NOT NULL, subject text,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE SET NULL,
  link_source text CHECK (link_source IN ('rule','model','user')),
  UNIQUE (connection_id, gmail_thread_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_threads_mandate ON comms.email_threads (mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_threads_counterparty ON comms.email_threads (counterparty_id);

CREATE TABLE comms.email_messages (               -- append-only
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  thread_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES comms.email_threads ON DELETE CASCADE,
  gmail_message_id text NOT NULL,
  direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('inbound','outbound')),
  sent_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  from_email citext NOT NULL,
  snippet text CHECK (length(snippet) <= 200),
  has_attachments boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  raw_input_id uuid,          -- the full message, body included; NULL for header-only rows copied from public.interactions; FK in rev 0015
  UNIQUE (thread_id, gmail_message_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_messages_thread_time ON comms.email_messages (thread_id, sent_at DESC) INCLUDE (direction);
CREATE INDEX ix_messages_sent_brin ON comms.email_messages USING brin (sent_at);

CREATE TABLE comms.email_participants (
  message_id uuid REFERENCES comms.email_messages ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email citext NOT NULL,
  role text NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('from','to','cc','bcc')),
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE SET NULL,
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (message_id, email, role));
CREATE INDEX ix_participants_person ON comms.email_participants (person_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_participants_org ON comms.email_participants (organization_id);   -- emails log per company
CREATE INDEX ix_participants_email ON comms.email_participants (email);

CREATE TABLE comms.email_attachments (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  message_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES comms.email_messages ON DELETE CASCADE,
  gmail_attachment_id text NOT NULL, file_name text NOT NULL, mime_type text,
  size_bytes bigint CHECK (size_bytes >= 0),
  UNIQUE (message_id, gmail_attachment_id));

CREATE TABLE comms.thread_triage (                 -- Home "To reply"
  thread_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES comms.email_threads ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  is_actionable boolean NOT NULL, suggested_action text, classifier_version text NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (state IN ('open','replied','not_actionable','snoozed','done')),
  snoozed_until timestamptz, CHECK (state <> 'snoozed' OR snoozed_until IS NOT NULL));
CREATE INDEX ix_triage_home ON comms.thread_triage (user_id) WHERE state = 'open' AND is_actionable;

CREATE TABLE comms.classifier_feedback (           -- append-only; trains the filter
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  thread_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES comms.email_threads ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  label text NOT NULL CHECK (label IN ('actionable','not_actionable')));
CREATE INDEX ix_feedback_thread ON comms.classifier_feedback (thread_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_feedback_user ON comms.classifier_feedback (user_id);

CREATE TABLE comms.calendar_events (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  connection_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES comms.user_connections ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  google_event_id text NOT NULL,
  starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL, ends_at timestamptz NOT NULL CHECK (ends_at >= starts_at),
  title text, is_cancelled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  UNIQUE (connection_id, google_event_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_events_agenda ON comms.calendar_events (connection_id, starts_at) WHERE NOT is_cancelled;
CREATE INDEX ix_events_mandate ON comms.calendar_events (mandate_id);

CREATE TABLE comms.calendar_attendees (
  event_id uuid REFERENCES comms.calendar_events ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email citext NOT NULL,
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE SET NULL,
  response text CHECK (response IN ('accepted','declined','tentative','needs_action')),
  is_organizer boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  PRIMARY KEY (event_id, email));
CREATE INDEX ix_attendees_person ON comms.calendar_attendees (person_id);

-- Scribe meetings (replaces public.meetings; data copied in the cutover).
CREATE TABLE comms.meetings (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  install_id text NOT NULL, local_recording_id text NOT NULL,
  recorded_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title text, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL, duration_seconds integer CHECK (duration_seconds >= 0),
  counterparty_role text CHECK (counterparty_role IN ('buyer','seller','investor','internal','general')),
  organization_id uuid REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE SET NULL,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE SET NULL,
  calendar_event_id uuid REFERENCES comms.calendar_events ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('received','summarizing','summarized','published','failed')),
  summary_started_at timestamptz, failure_code text,
  gist text, deal_momentum text, attio_note_record_id text UNIQUE,
  UNIQUE (install_id, local_recording_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_meetings_org_time ON comms.meetings (organization_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_meetings_mandate_time ON comms.meetings (mandate_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_meetings_counterparty ON comms.meetings (counterparty_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_meetings_event ON comms.meetings (calendar_event_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_meetings_recorder ON comms.meetings (recorded_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_meetings_stalled ON comms.meetings (summary_started_at) WHERE status = 'summarizing';

CREATE TABLE comms.meeting_transcripts (          -- heavy text kept off the hot table
  meeting_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES comms.meetings ON DELETE CASCADE,
  transcript text NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE comms.meeting_summary_items (        -- replaces summary_json
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  meeting_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES comms.meetings ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('note','decision','action_item','claim_to_verify','risk','keyword')),
  topic text, position smallint NOT NULL, body text NOT NULL,
  owner_name text, due_on date,                    -- action items only
  UNIQUE (meeting_id, kind, position));

CREATE TABLE comms.touchpoints (                  -- the business log of every contact; append-only
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organizations ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE SET NULL,
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE SET NULL,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('email','meeting','whatsapp','linkedin','call','in_person')),
  direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('outbound','inbound')),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('intro','follow_up','reply','owner_approach','client_email','document_request','cim','engagement_letter','other')),
  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  template_code text,
  email_message_id uuid REFERENCES comms.email_messages ON DELETE SET NULL,   -- one row per deal the email concerns
  link_source text CHECK (link_source IN ('thread','rule','code_name','user')),
  meeting_id uuid REFERENCES comms.meetings ON DELETE SET NULL,
  logged_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,
  summary text);
CREATE INDEX ix_tp_counterparty_time ON comms.touchpoints (counterparty_id, occurred_at DESC);  -- outreach state
CREATE INDEX ix_tp_org_time ON comms.touchpoints (organization_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_tp_person ON comms.touchpoints (person_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_tp_mandate_time ON comms.touchpoints (mandate_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_tp_meeting ON comms.touchpoints (meeting_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_tp_logged_by ON comms.touchpoints (logged_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_tp_reply_stats ON comms.touchpoints (template_code, occurred_at) WHERE direction = 'outbound';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tp_message_deal ON comms.touchpoints (email_message_id, mandate_id) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
  WHERE email_message_id IS NOT NULL;   -- an email counts once per deal; "Not about a deal" is the NULL mandate

-- Close the forward references from earlier revisions.
ALTER TABLE core.notes ADD CONSTRAINT fk_notes_meeting FOREIGN KEY (meeting_id) REFERENCES comms.meetings ON DELETE SET NULL;
ALTER TABLE intake.field_proposals ADD CONSTRAINT fk_fp_meeting FOREIGN KEY (meeting_id) REFERENCES comms.meetings ON DELETE SET NULL;
ALTER TABLE intake.field_proposals ADD CONSTRAINT fk_fp_message FOREIGN KEY (email_message_id) REFERENCES comms.email_messages ON DELETE SET NULL;
-- rev 0010_outreach
CREATE TABLE outreach.approval_batches (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('outreach','owner_approach','cim','follow_up')),
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','sending','sent')),
  decided_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT, decided_at timestamptz);
CREATE INDEX ix_batches_pending ON outreach.approval_batches (created_by) WHERE status = 'pending';
CREATE INDEX ix_batches_decider ON outreach.approval_batches (decided_by);

CREATE TABLE outreach.drafts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reply','intro','follow_up','owner_approach','client_email','document_request','cim','engagement_letter')),
  sender_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  thread_id uuid REFERENCES comms.email_threads ON DELETE SET NULL,
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE SET NULL,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  approval_batch_id uuid REFERENCES outreach.approval_batches ON DELETE SET NULL,
  subject text, body text NOT NULL,
  template_code text, model text, prompt_version text,
  codename_check text NOT NULL CHECK (codename_check IN ('passed','blocked','not_applicable')),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','approved','sent','rejected','failed')),
  approved_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT, approved_at timestamptz,
  sent_message_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES comms.email_messages ON DELETE RESTRICT, sent_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (status NOT IN ('approved','sent') OR approved_by IS NOT NULL),       -- AI never sends
  CHECK (status <> 'sent' OR (sent_message_id IS NOT NULL AND codename_check <> 'blocked')));
CREATE INDEX ix_drafts_to_send ON outreach.drafts (sender_user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE status = 'draft';
CREATE INDEX ix_drafts_thread ON outreach.drafts (thread_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_drafts_counterparty ON outreach.drafts (counterparty_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_drafts_mandate ON outreach.drafts (mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_drafts_batch ON outreach.drafts (approval_batch_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_drafts_approver ON outreach.drafts (approved_by);

CREATE TABLE outreach.draft_recipients (
  draft_id uuid REFERENCES outreach.drafts ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email citext NOT NULL,
  role text NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('to','cc','bcc')),
  person_id uuid REFERENCES core.people ON DELETE SET NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (draft_id, email, role));
CREATE INDEX ix_recipients_person ON outreach.draft_recipients (person_id);

CREATE TABLE outreach.draft_attachments (
  draft_id uuid REFERENCES outreach.drafts ON DELETE CASCADE,
  generated_document_id uuid NOT NULL,             -- FK to docs.generated_documents added in rev 0012
  PRIMARY KEY (draft_id, generated_document_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_attachments_document ON outreach.draft_attachments (generated_document_id);

-- Every paid outside call (Apollo, Diffbot, PDL, Firecrawl, Google Places, Apify, Bedrock, web search)
-- lands in one ledger, priced in the provider's own unit and in USD.
CREATE SCHEMA usage;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA usage TO wusool_app, wusool_readonly;
CREATE TABLE ref.providers (
  code text PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL,
  unit text NOT NULL CHECK (unit IN ('credits','requests','pages','tokens','usd')),
  requires_approval boolean NOT NULL,              -- true for Apollo: a person clicks before credits are spent
  UNIQUE (code, requires_approval));

CREATE TABLE usage.budgets (                      -- a limit per provider per month, per user or firm-wide
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  provider_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES ref.providers ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,   -- NULL = firm-wide
  month date NOT NULL CHECK (month = date_trunc('month', month)::date),
  limit_amount numeric(14,4) NOT NULL CHECK (limit_amount > 0),
  set_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_budgets ON usage.budgets (provider_code, user_id, month) NULLS NOT DISTINCT;
CREATE INDEX ix_budgets_user ON usage.budgets (user_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_budgets_setter ON usage.budgets (set_by);

CREATE TABLE usage.ledger (                       -- append-only; remaining = budget - sum(amount)
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  provider_code text NOT NULL,
  provider_requires_approval boolean NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (provider_code, provider_requires_approval) REFERENCES ref.providers (code, requires_approval) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,       -- whose budget; NULL for system jobs
  approved_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,   -- the person who clicked
  CHECK (NOT provider_requires_approval OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL)),
  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  operation text NOT NULL,                          -- e.g. person_enrich, email_reveal, scrape, place_search, invoke
  job_code text,                                    -- the Engine job: enrich_counterparty, blurb, brief, email_filter ...
  model text,                                       -- Bedrock model id for AI calls
  quoted_amount numeric(14,4) CHECK (quoted_amount >= 0),   -- the cost shown before the click
  amount numeric(14,4) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0),        -- in the provider's unit
  cost_usd numeric(12,4) CHECK (cost_usd >= 0),
  input_tokens integer CHECK (input_tokens >= 0), output_tokens integer CHECK (output_tokens >= 0),
  latency_ms integer CHECK (latency_ms >= 0),
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE SET NULL,
  search_candidate_id uuid REFERENCES intake.search_candidates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  raw_input_id uuid,                                -- the provider's response; FK added in rev 0015
  external_request_id text,
  UNIQUE (provider_code, external_request_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_budget ON usage.ledger (user_id, provider_code, occurred_at DESC) INCLUDE (amount);      -- credits left
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_cost ON usage.ledger (provider_code, occurred_at DESC) INCLUDE (job_code, cost_usd);   -- monthly cost per job
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_provider ON usage.ledger (provider_code, provider_requires_approval);
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_approver ON usage.ledger (approved_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_counterparty ON usage.ledger (counterparty_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_candidate ON usage.ledger (search_candidate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_raw ON usage.ledger (raw_input_id);

-- What the credit preview and the refusal check read.
CREATE VIEW usage.v_budget_remaining AS
  SELECT b.provider_code, b.user_id, b.month, b.limit_amount,
         b.limit_amount - coalesce(sum(l.amount), 0) AS remaining
  FROM usage.budgets b
  LEFT JOIN usage.ledger l
    ON l.provider_code = b.provider_code
   AND l.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.user_id
   AND l.occurred_at >= b.month AND l.occurred_at < b.month + interval '1 month'
  GROUP BY b.id;

Views: outreach.v_counterparty_sequence derives first sent, follow-ups sent, replied at and next follow-up due (4 and 9 working days, Saturday and Sunday off) from comms.touchpoints, so the sequence is never stored twice. Reply rates per template and sector live in analytics.reply_stats (section 8).

5. work (phase 0, by 4 Dec)

Home's Approvals tab holds record changes only; emails waiting to send are outreach.drafts. Each kind of approval must carry the field it changes, enforced by checks.

-- rev 0011_work
CREATE TABLE work.approvals (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('stage_change','next_step','tasks','field_update','link_message')),
  owner_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE CASCADE,
  proposed_stage_code text REFERENCES ref.mandate_stages ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  proposed_status_code text REFERENCES ref.mandate_statuses ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  proposed_next_step text,
  field_proposal_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES intake.field_proposals ON DELETE CASCADE,
  evidence text NOT NULL,
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('gmail','scribe','drive','rule')),
  source_message_id uuid REFERENCES comms.email_messages ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source_meeting_id uuid REFERENCES comms.meetings ON DELETE SET NULL,
  model text, prompt_version text,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected')),
  decided_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT, decided_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (status = 'pending' OR (decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (kind <> 'stage_change' OR (mandate_id IS NOT NULL AND proposed_stage_code IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (kind <> 'next_step'    OR (mandate_id IS NOT NULL AND proposed_next_step IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (kind <> 'field_update' OR field_proposal_id IS NOT NULL));
CREATE INDEX ix_approvals_home ON work.approvals (owner_user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE status = 'pending';
CREATE INDEX ix_approvals_mandate ON work.approvals (mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_approvals_counterparty ON work.approvals (counterparty_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_approvals_message ON work.approvals (source_message_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_approvals_meeting ON work.approvals (source_meeting_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_approvals_decider ON work.approvals (decided_by);
ALTER TABLE work.approvals ADD CONSTRAINT ck_approvals_link_message
  CHECK (kind <> 'link_message' OR source_message_id IS NOT NULL);

-- A tied email: the deals it could belong to and which the advisor picked (one, several or none).
CREATE TABLE work.approval_link_options (
  approval_id uuid REFERENCES work.approvals ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE CASCADE,
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE CASCADE,  -- NULL when the person is the client
  chosen boolean,                                                          -- NULL until decided
  PRIMARY KEY (approval_id, mandate_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_alo_mandate ON work.approval_link_options (mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_alo_counterparty ON work.approval_link_options (counterparty_id);

CREATE TABLE work.tasks (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  title text NOT NULL CHECK (title <> ''),
  owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL,      -- NULL when Scribe could not tell
  due_on date,
  mandate_id uuid REFERENCES core.mandates ON DELETE SET NULL,
  counterparty_id uuid REFERENCES core.counterparties ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('proposed','open','done','cancelled')),
  approval_id uuid REFERENCES work.approvals ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CHECK (status <> 'proposed' OR approval_id IS NOT NULL),
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('manual','scribe','approval','slack')),
  source_meeting_id uuid REFERENCES comms.meetings ON DELETE SET NULL,
  snoozed_until timestamptz,
  done_at timestamptz, CHECK ((status = 'done') = (done_at IS NOT NULL)),
  attio_task_id text UNIQUE,
  created_by uuid REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_open ON work.tasks (owner_user_id, due_on) WHERE status = 'open';
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_mandate ON work.tasks (mandate_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_counterparty ON work.tasks (counterparty_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_approval ON work.tasks (approval_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_meeting ON work.tasks (source_meeting_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_creator ON work.tasks (created_by);
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_title_trgm ON work.tasks USING gin (title gin_trgm_ops) WHERE status IN ('open','proposed');  -- Cmd+K

CREATE TABLE work.daily_briefs (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  brief_date date NOT NULL,
  sent_at timestamptz, slack_ts text, model text NOT NULL, prompt_version text NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (user_id, brief_date));
CREATE TABLE work.daily_brief_items (
  brief_id uuid REFERENCES work.daily_briefs ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position smallint CHECK (position BETWEEN 1 AND 8),
  body text NOT NULL,
